shared_elements: circle or disc in low relief
justification: Both are stone carvings whose most conspicuous motif is a circular disc set against a field with horizontal bands of repeated ornament below it, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A is a free-standing, heavily eroded, roughly modelled monolith with vague biomorphic forms, while B is a crisp, flat, precisely tooled architectural relief of a many-spoked wheel with regular beaded and petal borders.
